name: Jest of the Uneven Bridge
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: touch

Target: creature touched

Duration: 1 round per level

Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

While the spell is active, it lays in wait for the target to falter. Should the target miss an attack, the spell triggers, dealing 10 points of phrenic damage to the target and subsequently ending the spell’s effect.

Additionally, if you possess at least one rank in the Sleight of Hand skill, the spell enhances your precision, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus on your next attack roll for as long as the spell remains in effect.
